_doc: Caption phrases, word for word ('|' separates on-screen phrases, Saisha-reel style).
hook: World Science Day | is on 10 November, | and these are | the five facts | that sound fake, | but they are 100% true.
intro: Hi, I am Mohd Ashaar, | science educator | at The Cub, | and number four | will blow your mind.
honey: Number one: | honey almost never spoils. | Honey found in | ancient Egyptian tombs, | thousands of years old, | was reportedly | still good to eat.
octo: Number two: | an octopus has | three hearts | and blue-coloured blood.
sun: Number three: | sunlight takes about | eight minutes | to reach Earth. | So we always see the sun | as it was | eight minutes ago.
venus: Number four: | on Venus, | one full spin takes | about 243 days, | but one trip around the Sun | takes only 225. | So a day on Venus | is longer than its year.
banana: Number five: | bananas are | slightly radioactive | because they contain | tiny amounts | of natural potassium, | and it is completely harmless.
cta: And which fact | surprised you the most? | Comment the number below.
